title: The Roman World
note: Rome's books, in reading order. Each stands in a zone of the city (content/rome/republican_rome.json) and belongs to one of the city's four ages (content/rome/city.json): the city you walk is the age of the latest book you have begun.

modules.title: The Speaker in the Forum
modules.intro: The Roman art of the speech, as it was taught in the last generation of the Republic: the five canons, the parts of a speech, the three styles, and the memory palace.
takeaways: Rhetoric has five parts: invention, arrangement, style, memory, and delivery.
A trained memory is a house of places walked in order, with a striking image set in each.

works.title: Rhetorica ad Herennium
works.read: Book I.2-4 (the five canons and the parts of a speech) and Book III.16-24 (the art of memory).
